title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Official Version Released: 13 Billion Activated Parameters Drive the Agent Market

content_html:
On July 31, the official version of DeepSeek-V4-Flash API quietly went live for public beta testing, marking a key step for this domestic large model company in the Agent field. Unlike the previous "Pro strong, Flash weak" hierarchical logic, after this update, the official version of Flash has approached or even surpassed the V4-Pro preview version from three months ago in multiple Agent benchmark tests.

Official data shows that the official version of V4-Flash scored 82.7 on Terminal Bench 2.1, 76.7 on Cybergym, and 70.3 on Toolathlon verified. Notably, this model has 284 billion parameters, with only 13 billion activated parameters, which is nearly an order of magnitude less than V4-Pro (activated 49 billion). DeepSeek clearly stated that this update involved "only re-training," and the model structure remained completely unchanged. This means that through optimization of training methods and data quality, the lightweight model is narrowing the gap with the flagship model in specific tasks.

The other highlight of this upgrade is the first official unveiling of DeepSeek's self-developed Agent framework, DeepSeek Harness. At the same time, V4-Flash natively supports the Responses API format promoted by OpenAI and is specifically adapted for Codex. Developers can low-costly migrate OpenAI ecosystem Agent applications to the DeepSeek platform.

The strategic intent is very clear: to enter the Agent application market with a high-cost-performance lightweight model. Agent scenarios are extremely sensitive to inference speed and cost; Flash's low price advantage will form a significant competitive edge in multi-turn tasks that repeatedly call tools.

This release came less than two months after DeepSeek completed its first round of financing exceeding 50 billion yuan, and the company's valuation has risen to about 71 billion US dollars. With capital support, DeepSeek is accelerating from "no funding, no listing" to a commercialization sprint. As the official version of Pro is about to arrive, the curtain on the Agent war has already been lifted.

content_html_zh:
7月31日，DeepSeek-V4-Flash API正式版悄然上线公测，标志着这家国内大型模型公司在Agent领域迈出了关键一步。 与之前“Pro强，Flash弱”的分层逻辑不同，此次更新后，Flash正式版在多项Agent基准测试中已经逼近甚至超越了三个月前的V4-Pro预览版。

官方数据显示，经验证，V4-Flash 正式版在 Terminal Bench 2.1 上得分为 82.7，在 Cyber​​gym 上得分为 76.7，在 Toolathlon 上得分为 70.3。 值得注意的是，该模型有 2840 亿个参数，但激活参数只有 130 亿个，比 V4-Pro（激活的 490 亿个）少了近一个数量级。 DeepSeek明确表示，本次更新涉及“仅重新训练”，模型结构完全保持不变。 这意味着，通过训练方法和数据质量的优化，轻量级模型正在缩小与旗舰模型在特定任务上的差距。

此次升级的另一个亮点是DeepSeek自主研发的Agent框架DeepSeek Harness首次正式亮相。 同时，V4-Flash原生支持OpenAI推广的Responses API格式，并专门针对Codex进行了适配。 开发者可以低成本地将OpenAI生态系统Agent应用迁移到DeepSeek平台。

战略意图非常明确：以高性价比的轻量级模式进军Agent应用市场。 Agent场景对推理速度和成本极其敏感； Flash的低廉价格优势将在重复调用工具的多轮任务中形成显着的竞争优势。

此次发布距离DeepSeek完成首轮融资超过500亿元人民币不到两个月，公司估值已升至约710亿美元。 在资本支持下，DeepSeek正在加速从“不融资、不上市”到商业化冲刺。 随着Pro正式版即将到来，特工大战的帷幕已经拉开。
